# reselling_os_versions (Data Source)

Installable operating system versions and app templates; their `id` is the `os_version_id` of a rootserver.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_os_versions" "debian" {
  name    = "debian"
  version = "12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only systems whose name contains this text (case-insensitive), for example `debian`.
- `version` (String) Only this exact version, for example `12`.

### Read-Only

- `versions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `min_cores` (Number)
- `min_disk_gb` (Number)
- `min_ram_gb` (Number)
- `os_name` (String)
- `type` (String) `os` or `app`.
- `version` (String)
